spanish: Y grasa de cadáver y grasa de despedazado se hará a toda obra, y de ningún modo la comerán.
grammarChanges: Replaced the gerund-plus-finite-verb calque "comiendo no la comerán" (a smoothing of the qal infinitive absolute + imperfect) with the emphatic adverbial negation "de ningún modo la comerán", removing the manner reading while keeping the 2mp ustedes address and the repeated-eating force.
readerNote: Chose an emphatic-negation phrasing over the ambiguous gerund to avoid a manner reading, keeping the same prohibition and addressee.
